purpose: Test whether the minimum source portfolio can reconstruct point-in-time CRE events and eligible establishments before Codex implementation.

sample_frames.description: 100 nonresidential Brampton permits stratified by input year, status and work type
100 Mississauga permits stratified by application year, building type, scope and value
200 Mississauga businesses linked across 2019, 2024 and 2025 directories
100 federal records across Job Bank, LMIA, contracts, grants and regulated sources linked or intentionally unmatched

review_tasks: identify real physical establishment at prediction date
classify event truth and brokerage captureability separately
record earliest observable precursor and all six clocks
identify alternative explanations and negative evidence
adjudicate expansion, relocation, renewal, contraction, formation, displacement or no verified event
mark source failure, censoring and unresolved identity separately
rejection_rules: candidate-universe coverage is too low or systematically biased
permit-to-occupier attribution is not reliable enough
publication lag makes the proposed signal non-actionable
most positives are already committed/completed and not capturable
federal records cannot be linked to operating locations
source terms do not authorize intended retention or integration
